package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
)

func main() {
	var n, k, l, c, d, p, nl, np int
	fmt.Scan(&n, &k, &l, &c, &d, &p, &nl, &np)

	drinkToasts := (k * l) / nl
	limeToasts := c * d
	saltToasts := p / np

	totalToasts := int(math.Min(math.Min(float64(drinkToasts), float64(limeToasts)), float64(saltToasts)))

	answer := totalToasts / n
	fmt.Println(answer)
}

package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	reader := bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin)
	line, _, _ := reader.ReadLine()
	parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(line)), " ")

	var n, k, l, c, d, p, nl, np int
	_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[0], "%d", &n)
	_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[1], "%d", &k)
	_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[2], "%d", &l)
	_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[3], "%d", &c)
	_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[4], "%d", &d)
	_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[5], "%d", &p)
	_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[6], "%d", &nl)
	_, _ = fmt.Sscanf(parts[7], "%d", &np)

	// Total toasts possible based on each resource
	drinkToasts := (k * l) / nl
	limeToasts := c * d
	saltToasts := p / np

	// Minimum of all resources
	minToasts := drinkToasts
	if limeToasts < minToasts {
		minToasts = limeToasts
	}
	if saltToasts < minToasts {
		minToasts = saltToasts
	}

	// Each friend gets equal number of toasts
	answer := minToasts / n

	fmt.Println(answer)
}
